definitions.explanation: An observable sign that suggests something is about to happen or is already developing. Used for both medical symptoms and broader indications of change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兆候|ちょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兆候|ちょうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There were no signs of an earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兆候|ちょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れたら→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧べきだ。
examples.english: If symptoms of illness appear, you should go to the hospital immediately.

notes:
Used in both medical and general contexts. In medical usage, it refers to observable signs or symptoms of a disease. In everyday usage, it refers to early indicators of a coming change or event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兆候|ちょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (signs are visible)
- {兆候|ちょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ (signs appear)
- {兆候|ちょうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (show signs)
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兆候|ちょうこう} (signs of recovery)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兆候|ちょうこう} (symptoms of illness)
